title: Layer 2: Normalized schema (features/02_schema)
description: Normalized schema in Rust with serde: Message, Role, Part (Text, Thinking, ToolCall, ToolResult, Attachment, System), Provenance, Timestamp, and raw passthrough via serde_json::Value for agent-specific fields. Specs first: features/02_schema/*.feature.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Recorded the twelve schema recommendations from the five-agent storage survey as layer-2 Gherkin specs (features/02_schema/01_usage_tokens, 02_tool_result_status, 03_session_graph, 04_turn_grouping, 05_compaction, provenance extension, 07_tool_call_arguments, 08_inline_data, 09_optional_timestamp, 10_role_mapping, 11_session_metadata, 12_raw_blob_escape_hatch). All new scenarios tagged wip and excluded from the cucumber run (tests/bdd.rs filter) until implemented; embedded in the ch02 rustdoc chapter; spec tasks closed, implementation tasks open with blocked-by deps. Spec commit 4c81421.
